snippet.title: MOTOSCAFO showcase
snippet.description: Choose the loadout for your speedboat, and get ready to to save the day in this topdown 2D action shooter! Make your way to save the people of Hostia Bay from the threats of weird gangs, cartoony villains and big monsters — be the hero that injustice fears, be MOTOSCAFO!
